rationale: The hidden packaged runs use the same serialized state for Skia and Three.js across all six locked villa fixtures.
Four masks exercise Three.js output. Four feedback masks and the light and shadow samples exercise the shared Stage 2 Skia and React Native composite.
Every measured mask passes the locked baseline-signal, contrast-retention, channel-delta, coverage, and outside-mask thresholds.
The shared Stage 2 district-lighting and atmosphere overlays preserve the approved treatment without hiding atlas or geometry defects.
Destination, journal, and failure feedback stay above district lighting and atmosphere.
The temporary color transform qualifies only local and smoke comparison output. The shipping Three.js shader is not qualified in Stage 2.
The approved richer GPU lighting and ACES tone mapping remain deferred until Stage 4.
